Body Composition

We collect these details to help us understand your current movement readiness and support you safely in your training journey. 

Gymnastics‑based activities place unique demands on the body, and knowing your starting point helps us determine the most appropriate and supportive way for you to begin. 

For some participants this may be in group classes, while others may start with one‑to‑one sessions so we can guide pacing, build foundations, and help you progress with confidence. 

,Please Remember: ,tag,span,font-weight,bold,This information is never used to judge or assess your worth — it simply helps us create a pathway that feels safe, achievable, and aligned with your individual needs.
,tag,div

We’ll begin by reviewing your application. If we need any additional information or clarification, we’ll get in touch.
